meeting.summary: Discussion only; no action taken. Councilmembers Wood and Huish were excused. MHTN Architects presented a feasibility study for a new City Hall, and project manager Jen Dalley ran a live poll asking the council and staff which features matter most, with a focus on young families, city staff and elected officials. Director of Administrative Services Kimberly Ruesch then led a sticky-note exercise in which councilmembers sorted long-term General Fund capital projects, mainly parks, recreation and transportation, into 1–3 year, 5–10 year and 10-plus year priorities. The minutes do not record which projects landed where.
